headline: US Department of Energy authorizes emergency exchange of up to 4 million barrels of SPR crude due to Hurricane Isaias
source_time_text: Forex Factory Oct 10 9:13pm (site timezone not verified); official DOE release dated Oct 10; first independently timestamped DOE syndication Oct 10 20:26 UTC

learning_v2.reason: No matching ACTIONABLE evidence combination for delayed weekend supply-response story; applicable NEW_CATALYST next_session mixed_neutral ACTIONABLE says KEEP_NEUTRAL.

evidence.dominant_driver: US DOE permits up to 4m barrels of temporary SPR crude exchanges to help refineries after Hurricane Isaias; 2m each for ExxonMobil and BP, Exxon delivery partly acceleration of an earlier award.

market_expectations.distribution_notes: Hurricane oil shut-ins known in advance; incremental DOE response not quantifiably anticipated.

absorption.reason: Hurricane production disruption was already known and Friday prices reflected it; DOE response is new Saturday and no market response can be measured while exchanges are closed.

evidence.decision_notes: Official DOE statement and independent Reuters confirm terms. Event age measured from 20:26 UTC syndication; actual DOE first publication time uncertain. The 4m bbl are exchange/loans to be returned with premium in 2027, not 4m bbl of new net world oil production. Fixed intraday horizons occur during weekend; do not shift to next session. Ineligible for hit-rate.
